evidence.note: ETS enables training-free sampling from an optimal RL-aligned policy by combining a reference model with an energy term over Masked Language Modeling, estimating the energy via online Monte Carlo with a provable convergence rate, and using acceleration frameworks plus importance sampling to substantially reduce inference latency while provably preserving sampling quality on both autoregressive and diffusion language models.
evidence.title: ETS: Energy-Guided Test-Time Scaling for Training-Free RL Alignment
